steps.title: A second map
steps.body: A quest often leads to another map. Add a map named Old Well Cave, a spawn point named Cave path on this map, a gate joining them in the World graph, and a zone named Old well in the cave.
steps.task: Join Old Well Cave to this map.

steps.title: A goal on another map
steps.body: Write a quest named Into the Cave that extends MainQuest. Its first step's goal, the Old well, is on Old Well Cave: map names the map (On map in the Steps panel). Without map, a name is looked for on this map first, then on every other.

code: { name: "Find the old well", do: "reach", at: "Old well", map: "Old Well Cave" },
{ name: "Back out of the cave", do: "reach", at: "Cave path" },

steps.title: The way there
steps.body: Press Play. The goal is not on this map, so the diamond goes on the way out that leads to it: the Cave path gate (through several maps, the first gate or zone of the shortest road). The HUD says Find the old well — in Old Well Cave, and so do the quest log and the pause map.

args.name: Into the Cave
code: { name: "Find the old well", do: "reach", at: "Old well", map: "Old Well Cave" },
{ name: "Back out of the cave", do: "reach", at: "Cave path" },

steps.title: Through the gate
steps.body: Walk onto the Cave path. In Old Well Cave the diamond is on the well itself.

steps.title: Reach the well
steps.body: Walk into the Old well. The next step, Back out of the cave, has its goal on the first map: the diamond moves to the gate back.

steps.title: Out again
steps.body: Go back through the gate: arriving on the Cave path finishes the quest.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: Any step can lead anywhere in the game: name its map when the same name is on several. In code, quest.goalMap("Into the Cave") says which map a quest's goal is on, and goalOf can return a place on another map.
